name: Basetha
description: A jackal initiate of the Tah crop, twin of Setha, who crosses to Bontu with a heart.

timeline.summary: The ammit chases the last runners into the corridor and a blade kills Setha.
timeline.quote: a rogue blade reduced Setha to a black and red smear of viscera.

timeline.summary: The initiates turn on each other for hearts: Neit kills an initiate, Kamat fights Neit, and Nassor kills Tarik.
timeline.quote: Neit was charging across toward the scales
